text: Done: I moved the Bids slider from 68 to 80. Each bid now sits about 2.5% under fair, down from about 3.1%, so more bids go up and fill. Every bid still has to clear the slider's minimum edge and the same +EV checks. Money limits are unchanged. If bid fills come in below the closing line over 100+ fills, I'll set it back to 68.
